pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark-colored regions with moderately rounded vertices. The edge gradients are distinct but not sharp. Patch area is heterogeneous, being larger on the upper neck and shoulder regions and smaller with increased fragmentation toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned negative-space network with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor pathways are wider in the anterior-dorsal region and narrower toward the posterior-ventral region.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian organisms (oxpeckers) are present, clinging to the dorsal ridge, upper neck, and lower flank, creating localized occlusions of the pelage pattern.
